attributes.action: Protect Existing Skilled Workers from Retrospective ILR Settlement Changes
attributes.additional_details: Families moved to the UK in good faith, leaving careers and homes behind, relying on the five-year ILR route. They work, pay NI, IHS and taxes. The proposed £50,271 threshold is unfair and ignores household income; extending settlement means extra fees and employer dependence. Children suffer too: they sense their parents’ fear and worry about losing homes, schools, friends and their future. Many cannot realistically return. Protect existing residents and children from retrospective changes.
attributes.background: Exclude existing Skilled Worker visa holders already living in the UK from the new settlement rules. Honour their original five-year ILR pathway and protect their dependant partners and children's futures.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Protect the five-year ILR route for existing Skilled Workers" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785621
